999008199.text: お、お二人とも……よくお帰りなさいました
千歳殿！　拙者と永遠、ただいま戻ったでござる！

localizations.en: Chitose! Towa and I have returned!

999008199.text:
ご無事なようで何よりです……
永遠様と顔を合わせるのは、ひ、久方ぶりでしょうか

localizations.en: I'm so relieved you're both safe... It's been quite a while since I've seen you, hasn't it, Towa?

999008199.text:
修行の後、すぐに任務に出ちまったからな。
会えて飛び上がるほど嬉しいよ、千歳

localizations.en: I went straight on a mission after my training. I'm so happy to see you, I could jump for joy, Chitose.

999008199.text: 千歳殿も、ここで鏑矢様を待っているのでござるか？

localizations.en: Are you also waiting here for Lady Kaburaya, Chitose?

999008199.text: はい。私は本日のお勤めを終えたので……

localizations.en: Yes. I've finished my duties for today...

999008199.text:
鏑矢様は今、中央からの視察の対応をしています……
恐らく、もうまもなく終わる頃かと……

localizations.en: Lady Kaburaya is currently handling an inspection from the central government... It should be finishing up soon, I believe...

999008199.text:
中央からの視察の対応か。
ケイウン国南部の当主というのも大変だな

localizations.en: An inspection from the central government, huh? Being lady of southern Keiun certainly keeps her busy.

999008199.text:
ですが、これも統治には大切なことでござる。
鏑矢様のおかげで皆、平和に暮らせているのですから

localizations.en: But this is also an important part of governance. Thanks to Lady Kaburaya, everyone can live peacefully.

999008199.text:
だからといって、そのたびに文句を聞かされるのもね。
俺たちの身にもなってほしいものさ

localizations.en: Even so, having to listen to complaints every time gets tiresome. I wish they'd put themselves in our shoes once in a while.

999008199.text:
そうだ、鏑矢を待つ間、
三人で茶屋でも行かないかい？

localizations.en: Say, while we're waiting for Kaburaya, why don't the three of us head to a tea house?

999008199.text:
いつも行くあの茶屋もいいが、
さっき見つけた向こうの茶屋がなかなか良さそうで――

localizations.en: That place we always go to is nice, but I spotted another tea house earlier that looked quite promising—

999008199.text:
さっき見つけた茶屋の美女に
接近するつもりなのでござろう。まったく……

localizations.en: You're planning to approach that beautiful woman from the tea house you just found, aren't you? Really...
Oh, is that who I think it is over there?!

999008199.text: 戻ったのだな、鬼門！　永遠！

堂免家付きの巫女。
物静かで儚い印象だが、内には一つの芯がある

localizations.en: A shrine maiden serving the Doumen family. Though she appears quiet and fragile, she possesses an inner strength.
